observations.text: Long horizontal washes left pale lanes.
Crossing washes formed a visible grid.
Diagonal bridges quieted most gaps; contact shadow became a strong rail.
Broad looped copper block-in retained a blue central slit.
Crossing body planes closed the slit; shoulder remained faceted.
Densely sampled spout rose continuously from a joined root.
Open handle arch established; right end floated above shoulder.
Copper collars joined handle; knob filled.
Warm left and cool right planes separated; cool patch had raised edge.
Single compact loaded shoulder reflection survived whole view.
Cloth filled but read as a blue block.
Fold faces appeared; crease was isolated and dark.
Slate neighbor interrupted crease; contact cover changed color but added wavy relief, confirmed lower close.
Loaded neighbors warmed middle while leaving raised scallops.
Outside washes quieted pale background lanes.
Thin oil patina visible; spout-root patch isolated.
Warm neighbor connected patina; new lid seam became a dark rail.
Broad matching copper softened seam color but retained relief; upper view showed detached inner handle reflection.
Watercolor barely changed oil handle reflection; left seam endpoint softened more than right.
Long oblique cloth face clarified fold, retaining rounded silhouette.
Lower washes reduced pale border; spout turn warmer; lid endpoint retained relief.
Final cloth neighbor, outer washes and copper touch settled color; stop before additional raised covers.
